summary: The diff implements all major requirements for Reema's Italian Studio. All five pages (Home, Lessons, Videos, About, Contact) are created with client-side routing using TanStack Router. Navigation, Footer, lesson cards, video cards, and Italian flag theming are all present. The implementation is comprehensive and closely matches the spec. Minor observations: TanStack Router is used instead of React Router (spec says React Router), and the hero-banner image is used as a low-opacity background rather than a prominent accent — both are minor deviations. All content, components, and styling requirements appear satisfied.

missing_requirements.requirement: Use React Router for navigation between pages.
missing_requirements.reason: The diff uses @tanstack/react-router instead of React Router (react-router-dom). The spec explicitly states 'Use React Router for navigation between pages.'

hallucinated_features.description: Caffeine.ai attribution link in the footer
hallucinated_features.reason: The spec does not request any caffeine.ai branding or attribution in the footer. This was added without being requested.

hallucinated_features.description: InternetIdentityProvider wrapping the entire app in main.tsx
hallucinated_features.reason: The spec explicitly states no user authentication or login system is needed, and no backend canister calls are needed. Wrapping the app in InternetIdentityProvider is unnecessary and not requested.

hallucinated_features.description: QueryClientProvider and TanStack React Query setup in main.tsx
hallucinated_features.reason: No data fetching or query management was requested. All content is static/dummy data. Including React Query infrastructure is beyond the spec.
The spec explicitly states no backend logic or data persistence is required. Adding a backend actor file was not requested.
